## About
Lewis and Sons started when a son went to work with his father, Bud Lewis, Sr., over summers and school breaks. Father and son later decided to venture out on their own, and Lewis and Sons Air Conditioning, Inc. was born.
Today the business is still family-owned and operated. Bud Lewis, Jr. and his brother carry on the family tradition, with hopes that someday their sons will do the same. The company is dedicated to the memory of Benjamin F. Lewis, Sr., father and founder.
We handle sales, service, repair and installation of heating and cooling equipment for homes and businesses across Mesa and the metro Phoenix area.

## Services
- Heating and cooling service and repair: Diagnosing and fixing problems with your heating and cooling equipment.
- Heating and cooling installation: Sales and installation of heating and cooling equipment for homes and businesses.
- Mini splits: Jeff and Bud installed a mini split in one customer's garage.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work across the metro Phoenix area, including Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Scottsdale and Gilbert.

Q: Do you work on commercial systems?
A: Yes. We handle sales, service, repair and installation for both commercial and residential heating and cooling equipment.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
